summary: Chunghwa Telecom furnished a routine Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report) reporting unaudited August 2026 consolidated results and monthly sales disclosure. August revenue was roughly NT$23.31 billion, operating income NT$5.62 billion, net income attributable to parent NT$4.44 billion, EBITDA NT$9.05 billion, EPS NT$0.57; eight-month revenue NT$164.55 billion, EPS NT$3.68. August net sales rose 25.61% year over year. Derivatives, lending and guarantee disclosures were immaterial. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms; no special-situation or risk-arb angle.
